answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using micro-refractive attestation. Nodes direct broadband light through a quartz prism submerged in a cedar oil bath, creating a calibrated optical oasis whose spectral dispersion pattern verifies physical presence. Attackers incur the verifiable hardware cost of provisioning discrete spectrometer stages per identity. However, thermal drift shifts oil viscosity and refractive indices over time, causing calibration errors.
